syllabus_extract: Basic concept of ESM. Types of Information extracted like PRF, PRT, and PW etc. and their utilization for verifying types of Radar.
specific_objectives: 18.1.4.1 Trainee will be able to appraise the function of secondary radars in ASW operation.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of ESM parameter definitions and Radar type identification logic based on extracted data; Safety: No live equipment handling; Instructor supervision: Monitor understanding of PRF/PRT/PW relationships.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an Electronic Support Measures (ESM) system?
How does an ESM system differ from an Electronic Counter Measures (ECM) system?
Why is the identification of radar types critical in Anti-Submarine Warfare (ASW) operations?

summary_questions: Explain how PRF and PRT values are used to distinguish between search and fire-control radars.
Describe the specific role of secondary radars in supporting ASW operations using ESM data.
List three key parameters extracted by ESM and their utility in verifying radar types.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the concepts of ESM discussed in this lesson will assist in analyzing radar threats in the upcoming lesson on Electronic Counter Measures (ECM).
